subject: [PATCH v2 1/8] memcg: remove v1 soft limit reclaim

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes the soft limit reclaim functionality from the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) v1 implementation. The soft limit rbtree is always empty, making the reclaim pass a no-op in both direct reclaim and kswapd. As a result, the code for soft limit reclaim is removed from memcontrol-v1.c and related functions are updated accordingly.
